# Sauna Import

> U.S. sauna trade and tariff classification research.

Core pages:
- https://saunaimport.com/data/ — Census trade-category dashboard
- https://saunaimport.com/classifications/ — sauna-relevant HTS classification research
- https://saunaimport.com/rulings/ — curated CBP sauna rulings
- https://saunaimport.com/methodology/ — data limitations and update method

Important limitation: tracked HTS categories are broad and include non-sauna merchandise. Do not cite their totals as sauna-only imports or as total U.S. sauna market size.
